effect.name: GM Adaptive Comic Ink
effect.desc: Adaptive ink outlines, posterized paint regions and shadow hatching driven by local image structure.
effect.shader: float l(vec2 p){return dot(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p,0.0,1.0)).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0)),e=edgeWidthPx/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);float gx=l(uv+vec2(e.x,0))-l(uv-vec2(e.x,0)),gy=l(uv+vec2(0,e.y))-l(uv-vec2(0,e.y)),edge=smoothstep(edgeThreshold,edgeThreshold*2.5,length(vec2(gx,gy)));float lv=max(floor(levels+.5),2.0);vec3 paint=floor(src.rgb*lv+.5)/lv;float lum=l(uv),hatch=step(.5,fract((uv.x+uv.y*.65)*hatchScale))*(1.0-smoothstep(.05,.65,lum))*hatching;paint=mix(paint,inkColor.rgb,hatch);paint=mix(vec3(dot(paint,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722))),paint,sourceColor);vec3 outRgb=mix(paint,inkColor.rgb,edge);gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,outRgb,mixAmount),src.a);}
